checks.claim: Live program, nuclear not yet eligible
checks.evidence: Spartnerships, dated 2026-05-22, reports that the PUCT has unveiled a rule establishing the grant and loan process and that the commission has not released an application schedule. The article does not mention nuclear or small reactors, and gives gas, propane, solar and battery storage as the examples of qualifying fuel-source combinations. Nothing found after that date describes the program as open for applications.
